A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same RASTEER study. Their complete 23-page documents, including readable figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–F, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original component analyses and steering experiments on balanced parentheses, HumanEval, and arithmetic, with additional empirical results in Appendices A–D.

after.justification: v2 retains these original component analyses, steering evaluations, and appendix results. Results carried forward from v1 still qualify as original empirical evidence.

M1.justification: The component-selection algorithms, generalizability and promotion-based ranking, activation scaling, and arithmetic adaptation remain unchanged. Correcting an evaluated model's name does not alter RASTEER.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same four synthetic balanced-parentheses subtasks, HumanEval, and two-operand addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division tasks. No dataset, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The circuit-discovery baseline and unsteered controls remain unchanged in the corresponding comparisons. The corrected arithmetic-model label does not establish an additional comparator: v1 already lists Llama-3 8b in Appendix F.1.

E3.justification: Section 5.4.3 and Table 2 correct the reported arithmetic model from 'GPT-3 8b' to 'Llama3-8b.' This is a limited correction to the reported configuration, aligning it with v1's Appendix F.1. Scores, sample counts, metrics, decoding, and steering settings remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish a rerun.

E4.justification: Both retain the component-type and ranking-metric comparisons, steering-size sweeps, circuit-head overlap and intervention analyses, and investigation of GPT-2 Small's failure. Appendices B–D contain the same supplementary analyses.

E5.justification: Neither version adds repeated-run counts, random-seed information, confidence intervals, significance tests, or other uncertainty estimates. The statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Numerical results and empirical findings in Figures 1–10, Tables 1–6, and the HumanEval discussion are unchanged. Table 2's corrected model row retains all scores, including 82.33% to 84.33% for addition and 74.08% to 80.08% for multiplication.

T1.justification: The transformer equations, component-correctness and token-promotion definitions, and Appendix C's effect-score and circuit-faithfulness mathematics remain unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about faulty mechanisms overshadowing sound ones, RASTEER's steering benefits, preservation of general coding ability, and applicability to arithmetic.

C2.justification: The explanations involving noisy promotion, attention-head effectiveness, and circuit-steering instability are retained. Section 7 preserves the same limitations concerning synthetic data, additive mechanisms, heuristic ranking, and fixed scaling.

D1.justification: v2 adds a first-page footnote identifying a repository for the source code and dataset, providing access information absent from v1. Implementation settings, Appendix C's procedural details, and Appendix E's hardware disclosure are otherwise unchanged. Repository contents were not accessed.

R1.justification: Section 6 adds Miller, Rai, and Yao's 'Mechanistic understanding of language models in syntactic code completion.' A Llama-3 citation accompanies the corrected model label, although that work was already cited in v1. The broader research positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 shortens author-affiliation information, replaces the preprint notice with a NeurIPS 2025 notice, and corrects the arithmetic-model name. The prose, section sequence, and appendix organization are otherwise substantially retained.

P2.justification: The shortened author block and added footnote cause text reflow; Table 2 moves from page 11 to page 10 and its model-row label changes. Figures and tables retain their display structures, and no figure or table is added or removed.

improvement.justification: v2 improves internal consistency by aligning the arithmetic-model name in Section 5.4.3 and Table 2 with Appendix F.1, and improves reproducibility documentation through the new code-and-dataset link. The added related-work citation provides limited contextual benefit. Methods, empirical evidence, and limitations remain unchanged, so the overall gain is modest.
